title: Nighttime Magnesium Body Care Signature Trio
body_html:
🌙 Three Nighttime Favorites. One Signature Trio.

Meet the Magnum Solace Nighttime Magnesium Signature Trio — three full-size body care favorites designed to turn your evening routine into something you actually look forward to. 💜

You’ll get three distinct formulas and scent experiences, including our signature Arnica + Lavender Magnesium Lotion plus two rich Nighttime Magnesium Creams in Citrus Rose and Citrus Serenity.

Whether you’re moisturizing after a shower, massaging your legs and feet at the end of a long day, or simply adding a little more self-care to your evening, this trio gives you options for every mood.

✨ WHAT’S INSIDE

💜 Nighttime Magnesium Lotion with Arnica + Lavender — 5 oz
Smooth, moisturizing and easy to massage into the skin. Made with magnesium, arnica and lavender for an easy addition to your nighttime body care routine.

🌹 Nighttime Magnesium Cream — Citrus Rose — 5 oz
A rich, nourishing magnesium body cream with a bright, fresh Citrus Rose scent and a luxuriously creamy texture.

🍊 Nighttime Magnesium Cream — Citrus Serenity — 5 oz
A rich magnesium cream with a warm citrus-inspired scent — perfect when you want moisturizing body care with a little extra personality.

💫 THREE JARS. THREE EXPERIENCES.

Use one favorite every night or rotate between all three.

Arnica + Lavender for your classic nighttime routine.
Citrus Rose when you want something bright and fresh.
Citrus Serenity when you’re in the mood for warm citrus.

Altogether, you get three full-size 5 oz jars — 15 oz of Magnum Solace body care.

💜 WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

✨ 3 full-size 5 oz products
🌙 Made for your nighttime body care routine
💜 Includes Arnica + Lavender
🌹 Two additional magnesium cream scents
🧴 Rich, moisturizing formulas for dry skin
🙌 Great for legs, feet, arms and everyday body massage
🎁 An easy gift or introduction to Magnum Solace
🇺🇸 Made in the USA

Three nighttime favorites. One seriously good magnesium body care trio.
